stem.text: The mass spectrum of $\text{CH}_3\text{Cl}$ shows a molecular ion peak, $\text{M}^{+}$, at the $m/e$ value of 50 with a relative abundance of 18.0%.
Other peaks are present in the mass spectrum.
What is seen in the mass spectrum at the $m/e$ value of 52?

A.text: a peak with relative abundance of 4.5%

B.text: a peak with relative abundance of 6.0%

C.text: a peak with relative abundance of 18.0%

D.text: a peak with relative abundance of 54.0%
